items.name: De'Von Achane
items.note: Tore his left ACL; out for the season. His dynasty value from FantasyCalc already reflects the injury.

items.name: Terrance Ferguson
items.note: Needs season-ending ankle surgery, according to Sean McVay, so he won't return from IR this year. He should be ready for 2027.

items.name: Anthony Richardson
items.note: The Colts released Daniel Jones and named Richardson their starter for the rest of the season, beginning in Week 12 against the Giants.

items.name: Daniel Jones
items.note: Released by the Colts and went unclaimed on waivers, so he is a free agent with no starting job lined up.

items.name: Aaron Rodgers
items.note: The Steelers benched him for Friday's game against Denver and released him a day later. He's a 43-year-old free agent who had already called 2026 his final season.

items.name: Mason Rudolph
items.note: Takes over as Pittsburgh's starting quarterback after Aaron Rodgers was benched and released, starting with Friday's game against the Broncos.

items.name: J.K. Dobbins
items.note: Sean Payton suspended him for one game for conduct detrimental to the team. He should be back for the following week.
